# mcpstat for Visual Studio Code

> A VS Code extension for MCP server observability. View tool, prompt and resource
> usage, errors and measured latency recorded by the Python mcpstat library.

Requires VS Code 1.100+ and a server instrumented with mcpstat 0.3.0+. The extension
does not automatically instrument arbitrary MCP servers. Connect through VS Code's
registered statistics tool, Streamable HTTP, or an existing schema-4 SQLite database.
Python 3.10+ is needed only for SQLite access. The extension ID is
`vadikus.mcpstat-dashboard`; the source repository is `tekkidev/mcpstat-vscode`.

## Extension documentation

- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tekkidev/mcpstat-vscode/main/README.md): Setup, approval guidance, connections, chart semantics, limits and privacy.
- [Contributor guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tekkidev/mcpstat-vscode/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Independent build, F5 debugging, synthetic tests and VSIX packaging.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tekkidev/mcpstat-vscode/main/SECURITY.md): Private vulnerability reporting and the extension's security boundaries.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tekkidev/mcpstat-vscode/main/CHANGELOG.md): User-visible changes.
- [Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tekkidev/mcpstat-vscode/main/package.json): Commands, settings, capabilities and discovery metadata.

## Server integration

- [Integration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tekkidev/mcpstat/main/docs/quickstart.md): Add tracking and register get_tool_usage_stats in a Python MCP server.
- [Library documentation index](https://mcpstat.vadim.dev/llms.txt): Python API, supported contracts and server setup.
- [Full library reference](https://mcpstat.vadim.dev/llms-full.txt): Expanded Python library documentation.

- [Third-party notices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tekkidev/mcpstat-vscode/main/ThirdPartyNotices.md): Bundled dependencies, Bootstrap Icons and their licenses.
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/tekkidev/mcpstat-vscode/issues): Bug reports and feature requests; omit private data and credentials.
